data.topic: MLS 2021-2025 historical 1X2 odds gap recovery (Pinnacle / William Hill, opening + closing)

sources.name: football-data.co.uk
sources.semantics: C-suffixed columns (PSCH/PSCD/PSCA) are CLOSING odds. Per notes.txt: 'These are for pre-closing odds. For the closing odds, as below but with an additional C character following the bookmaker abbreviation (e.g. B365CH = closing Bet365 home win odds).' The consolidated MLS file contains closing odds only; no opening columns exist.

closing.note: 100% for 2021-2024 regular seasons and 2025 regular season; 15 missing rows are all 2025-10-26..2025-11-10 (MLS Cup playoffs)

opening.reason: football-data.co.uk publishes closing odds only (current consolidated file has no opening columns); no public bulk source for MLS opening odds was found

closing.reason: Not present in football-data.co.uk MLS file (only PS/Max/Avg/Betfair-Exchange/Bet365 closing columns). The legacy per-season format carrying WHH/WHD/WHA was never published for MLS (https://www.football-data.co.uk/mmz4281/<season>/USA.csv returns 404; verified 2026-10-01). Only per-match JS pages (e.g. OddsPortal) carry WH historically; bulk extraction of ~2500 matches is not feasible/verifiable in this pipeline.

opening.reason: Same as closing: no public bulk source for historical William Hill MLS odds.

duplicates.detail: no duplicate (season, kickoff date, home_team, away_team) groups in 2544 rows

conflicts.detail: no impossible odds values; observation (not a conflict): 38 rows have Pinnacle home > Max home * 1.02 and 54 rows have Pinnacle away > Max away * 1.02, suggesting the MaxCH/MaxCD/MaxCA columns exclude Pinnacle in some rows — do not treat Max as max-including-Pinnacle

data.unmatched_note: Requester-side fixture inventory was not provided; within this dataset 15/2544 rows lack Pinnacle closing (all 2025 playoffs, listed in missing_rows). No rows were merged or inferred.
